jobDescription: The observability platform collects the metrics, logs and traces of every service in the company and serves the dashboards and alerts the on-call engineers rely on. The Staff Software Engineer sets the platform's technical direction across its three teams: writes the technical strategy and the architecture decision records the teams build against, chairs the platform design review, represents the platform in the company's technical steering group, and coaches the senior engineers. Prior experience at staff level with technical direction set across more than one team is required. Reports to the head of observability; works with the three platform teams, the technical steering group and the SRE organisation.
requirements: Has operated at staff level, setting technical direction across more than one team.
Has written the technical strategy and the architecture decision records that other teams build against.
Chairs a design review and represents a platform in a technical steering group.
Coaches senior engineers under a documented coaching practice.
Documents what each decision record and each design review leaves open.

evidence.text: Staff Software Engineer for the observability platform of a cloud software company since 2022, setting the platform's technical direction across its ingestion, storage and query teams; senior software engineer on the storage team from 2018 to 2022.
Wrote the platform's technical strategy for 2023 and 2025 and the fourteen architecture decision records the three teams built against, all under my name in the platform's architecture repository.

Chaired the platform design review from 2022, with the review calendar and the review outcomes in the repository, and represented the platform in the company's technical steering group, where the steering group minutes record the platform items under my name.
Coached the five senior engineers across the three teams under the engineering coaching practice, with the coaching agreements filed with the engineering managers.
Wrote the open questions section of each decision record and the boundary note of each design review, stating what was left undecided.

Work sample: the 2025 technical strategy, two architecture decision records, one design review outcome with its boundary note and one steering group minutes extract, with the architecture repository references as a verification trail.

Recruiter screen: candidate said he has been the staff engineer setting direction across the three observability teams since 2022 and wrote the strategy and the decision records; the counts he gave match the resume.

Hiring manager pre-read: the head of observability asks the packet to cite the decision records by repository reference and the steering group minutes, and to show the senior engineer years separately.

propositions.text: The candidate has been Staff Software Engineer for a cloud software company's observability platform since 2022, setting the platform's technical direction across its ingestion, storage and query teams, after a senior software engineer role on the storage team from 2018 to 2022.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the staff role and the periods.

propositions.rationale: The resume, the strategy, the records and the steering group minutes document the authorship, the review chair and the representation.
